description: This file defines structures and functions related to architecture information in Mach-O binaries, including architecture info retrieval and CPU subtype management.

methods.name: NXGetAllArchInfos
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an array of all known architecture info structures.

methods.name: NXGetLocalArchInfo
methods.description: Returns the architecture info for the local host.

methods.name: NXGetArchInfoFromName
methods.description: Returns architecture info based on architecture name.

methods.name: NXGetArchInfoFromCpuType
methods.description: Returns architecture info based on CPU type and subtype.

methods.name: NXFindBestFatArch
methods.description: Selects the best matching fat architecture for given CPU type/subtype.

methods.name: NXCombineCpuSubtypes
methods.description: Combines two CPU subtypes for a given CPU type.
